messages:
Matt: Heads-up — ran the weekly RI/savings-plan audit and noticed a weird band of unused GPU-hours overnight in us-west-2 that don’t map to any active workloads :thinking_face:
Sophia: Can you paste the query / lines you saw?
Matt: Sure — pulled billing rows for last 7 days, filtered by instance type p4d and tagged cost-center. Snippet:
```
2026-03-10 03:00 UTC | p4d.24xlarge | us-west-2 | ReservationCoverage: 0% | OnDemandUsageHours: 46.2
2026-03-10 04:00 UTC | p4d.24xlarge | eu-west-1 | ReservationCoverage: 95% | OnDemandUsageHours: 2.1
```
Matt: The cost lines show reservation discounts applied mostly in eu-west-1, but instance spin-ups are in us-west-2 during nightly batch window. So RI coverage is effectively orphaned by region mismatch.
Anna: Oof. Do we have any regional RIs (zonal) vs regional Savings Plans misalignment?
Matt: We have a mix. A chunk of our reserved capacity was purchased as regional compute-savings (applied preferentially in eu), but some older zonal RIs are stuck in us-west-2 while the nightly pipelines migrated east last month during the network congestion workaround.
Luis: Any quick fixes that don't require exchanging big commitments?
Sophia: Short term: shift scheduled batch jobs to prefer eu-west-1 during the nightly window, or add a tiny dedicated pool in us-west-2 and attach spot to absorb the delta. Medium term: consider partial exchange to regional SavingsPlan or staggered renewals timed to when pipelines permanently move.
Matt: I don’t want to move everything overnight. For visibility, I pushed a dashboard query to show hourly RI utilization by AZ and tag. billing-bot posted a summary: 
""
billing-bot: Found 1650 GPU-hours in last 7 days where reservation discount did not apply; estimated wasted discount $12,200. Top contributor: nightly-training-job (tag: batch/nightly) running in us-west-2 between 02:00-05:00 UTC.
""
Anna: Can we get which reservation IDs are impacted? We might be able to modify scope or exchange a small slice.
Matt: Yup — sample reservation ids: r-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h, r-1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h. Those are zonal.
Sophia: If they are zonal, exchange is limited. We could utilize the AWS RI Marketplace if the term is expiring soon, or move the workloads to match.
Luis: Also worth checking autoscaler behavior — I remember a config tweak we shipped last month that increases min nodes for the nightly job to avoid OOMs. Might be forcing extra instances.
Matt: Good point. Link to autoscaler diff: <https://git.redwood/infra/patches/2134> — it bumps minReplicas from 2 to 5 for the training-spot pool.
Anna: If minReplicas is too high, we can set a schedule for it to drop during the day and only scale up in the evening for a smaller window.
Sophia: Proposal: 1) short window: schedule the batch to run in eu-west-1 where our regional savings apply for the next 4 weekly runs; 2) audit autoscaler minReplica for nightly jobs and revert if overprovisioned; 3) prepare an RI exchange/marketplace plan for the subset expiring next quarter.
Matt: I can whip up the change for the scheduled region preference and a one-off PR to reduce minReplicas during non-run hours. Will also attach a CSV of affected reservation ids and hours for finance.
Luis: Ping me when you open the PRs, I’ll run a quick cost sim to estimate delta.
billing-bot: Action created: INFR-3749 — "Nightly batch RI alignment + autoscaler audit" assigned to Matt, due 2026-03-17. :white_check_mark:
Sophia: Thanks. Quick checklist: - update batch schedule (Matt) - autoscaler audit & PR (Matt) - cost sim and exchange options (Luis) - finance CSV for marketplace (Matt)
Matt: Will update this thread with PR links and cost sim numbers. :thumbsup:
Sophia: :eyes:
